name: timeline-scrubber
title: Timeline Scrubber
description: See who or what occupies parallel lanes around a moment, and drag, flick or key that moment through time. Built for on-call rotations, bookings and other schedules where each moment has one owner per lane.

meta.intent: See who or what occupies parallel lanes around a moment, and move that moment through time.
meta.origin: Harvested from Bearing's support shift scrubber

docs: Wrap your app in TooltipProvider. Exports TimelineScrubber and withOverrides.
